page.overview:
Who is Taco?

Taco raced in the Thunder Hollow Crazy Eight race.

He is a yellow pick up truck resembling an 1980s ford pick up. He is one of 2 derby cars with extensive body damage. Due to his extensive participation in the derby, the midsection of his frame has been bend badly to the point of his bed section being pushed into his cab. Despite his shape, he is still able to move albeit at a limping pace.
